# ICJIA Markdown Editor

> A free, accessible, browser-based markdown editor built for Illinois Criminal Justice Information Authority (ICJIA) researchers. Write in a real-time twin-pane editor with live preview, export to Markdown or styled HTML, and full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility — all running entirely in your browser with no account, no server, and no document data leaving your device.

The ICJIA Markdown Editor is a statically generated web application (Nuxt 4 + CodeMirror 6) deployed at https://markdown.icjia.cloud. All editing happens client-side; documents are auto-saved to the browser's localStorage and are never uploaded. It is open source under the MIT license, published by the Illinois Criminal Justice Information Authority.

## What it does

- Real-time twin-pane editing: a CodeMirror 6 editor beside a live, scroll-synchronized markdown preview.
- Rich markdown: footnotes, task lists, strikethrough, inserted (`++ins++`) and highlighted (`==mark==`) text, tables, heading anchors, and KaTeX math (inline and block LaTeX).
- Formatting toolbar plus keyboard shortcuts for bold, italic, code, headings (H1–H6), block quotes, lists, links, tables, and horizontal rules.
- Visual table builder (Cmd/Ctrl+T) that generates markdown tables from a grid.
- Export: copy as Markdown or HTML to the clipboard, or download a Markdown file or a self-contained styled HTML document with a custom filename.
- Import: upload existing Markdown files (10 MB limit).
- Auto-save to localStorage every 30 seconds with a live countdown, plus one-click reset to the built-in tutorial content.
- Dark/light mode with system-preference detection (dark by default).
- Interactive 25-step guided tour for first-time visitors, restartable at any time.

## Key features

- Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliant (AAA in key areas such as status-bar contrast). Full keyboard navigation, screen-reader announcements via ARIA live regions, visible focus indicators, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support. Audited with axe-core (zero violations).
- Privacy and security: runs fully client-side with no analytics or telemetry; document content never leaves the browser. Rendered HTML is sanitized with DOMPurify, code-block language attributes and download filenames are sanitized, and uploads are size-limited to prevent crashes.
- Document statistics: live word count, character count, and estimated reading time in the status bar.

## Tech stack

- Framework: Nuxt 4 (Vue 3.5+, TypeScript 5.x), statically generated and deployed on Netlify.
- Editor: CodeMirror 6.
- Markdown: markdown-it 14 with footnote, task-list, strikethrough, ins, mark, anchor, and KaTeX plugins; highlight.js for code highlighting; DOMPurify for sanitization.
- UI: Nuxt UI 4 and VueUse 14.
